game_over_deathmatch_summary: Be the first to score {goal} kills in a Boxhead deathmatch room
tip_controls_title: Switch between eight-way movement and mouse aim
tip_controls_body: Classic Boxhead uses locked eight-way shooting by default; mouse cursor aiming is also available.
tip_combo_body: Every kill extends the combo timer. Reach milestones to permanently unlock weapons and upgrades.
tip_choke_title: Build a chain-reaction corridor with walls and barrels
tip_choke_body: Block a narrow route with fake walls, then detonate barrels or mines from behind the defense.
tip_devil_title: Red Devil fireballs damage every target
tip_devil_key: Use pillars for cover and redirect fireballs
tip_devil_body: Fireballs disappear on walls and also damage other zombies and bosses.
tip_supply_title: Red supply crates stay at P points until collected
tip_supply_key: Track red dots on the minimap
tip_supply_body: Red supply crates restore ammunition or health and never expire before collection.
tip_coop_title: Stand near a downed teammate to revive them
tip_coop_body: In co-op and AI partner modes, remain beside a downed teammate for about 1.2 seconds to revive them.
loading_title: Assembling the LEGO battlefield and loading combat resources…
split_swap_title: Swap the left and right deathmatch views
split_swap_summary: Split view order — Left: {left} / Right: {right} (click to swap)
controls_p1: P1 move: WASD{arrows} · Fire/place: Space/F · Switch: 1–0 or Q/E
rendering_technical_note: 2.5D Y-Sort occlusion + 5-second shell cleanup + live localStorage weapon evolution backup
controls_p2: P2: Arrow keys · / or Enter to fire · ,/. to switch weapons
